description: Hi! I’m a Software Engineering student interested in AI/ML, backend development, and innovative technology. My teammate and I are developing Outpost 30, a lunar-base simulation concept for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, combining Next.js, 3D rendering, Python, and FastAPI. We welcome collaborators interested in space science, simulation modelling, UI/UX, data visualization, and research. We’re excited to learn, collaborate, and build something impactful!
